EMERALD CHAMPIONS — MASTER BATTLE DESIGN
VERSION: 2
AUTHORING_STATUS: Exact loadouts and plans are authored in emerald_champions_battle_teams.txt; this file materializes them. The Game Book is the short design guide.
REGENERATION_RULE: Run emerald_champions_teams.py --write to materialize the team catalogue; --check verifies source agreement. IDs remain stable.
CHRONOLOGY_RULE: Current map geometry, scripts and flags determine reachability; the Game Book battle/access section records the reconciled early-access ledger. campaign_order, atlas_ordinal, chapter and strict_cap are inherited authoring/preview metadata, not runtime gates or proof of first access. Use current book milestones and live-cap offsets for encounter levels.

SCOPE
source_checkpoint: modern Pokemon Champions migration branch
rematch_free_physical_encounter_groups: 324
rematch_free_explicit_trainer_branch_blocks: 368
format_counts: derived from active branch records; retired encounter IDs remain reserved
doubles_policy: every campaign trainer battle is double or multi; the opening rival has four Pokemon and all standard opposing teams have at least four
excluded_content: ordinary Match Call tiers, Gym rematch families, and three phantom source-parser hits
included_content: 324 active authored encounter groups; excluded branches remain retired
battle_frontier_boundary: every live Frontier challenge desk enters the single endless Champions Circuit, generated in-ROM from the pinned Showdown Champions random-doubles port; the retired native facility generators are not campaign encounters

DESIGN THESIS
Every campaign battle is a bespoke, legal, readable puzzle. The player receives competitive Pokemon, moves, abilities, natures, EVs, and free ordinary held items; difficulty comes from decisions rather than grinding.
All campaign trainers use the live chapter cap plus their authored offset on Normal; Hard adds 2 and Easy subtracts 2, represented in the native 1..255 battle-level range; no level-100 opponent ceiling. Gyms and the opening doubles are included. Teams and expert AI stay identical across difficulty settings.
Mega Evolution is the only selectable gimmick. Player Mega access begins with Steven's post-Brawly bracelet/Aerodactylite handoff. Roxanne's explicitly authored Mega Aerodactyl is the earlier opponent-only introduction. Primals remain approved automatic forms.

STATIC SOURCE AUDIT — NOT FULL PLAYTEST ACCEPTANCE
champions_legality_repairs: 584 move slots normalized against Showdown bb179fbf8449e3c31632bd56f671ffb4404fa6e7
coverage: all 99 Mega Stone item types occur in retained parties; legendary-family coverage is 73/78 under the current explicit alias index, not blanket acquisition/showcase acceptance
cohesion_contract: exact authored/native materialization, live-cap levels, valid native moves/forms/abilities/items and 510/252 EVs; roster-pattern and reference comparisons are advisory, not design quotas.

REMATCH POLICY
Ordinary and Gym rematches are not campaign content. League replays reuse the finished League teams. Gabby and Ty remain only as distinct roaming reporter milestones. Repeatable endgame variety belongs to the live Champions Circuit reached from every Frontier challenge desk.

IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT
Implement every retained branch exactly: format, cap-relative levels, species, item, ability, nature, EVs, moves, AI requirements, and native dialogue intent. Build coherent changes and verify their relevant source, native behavior and artifact identity. Static checks do not certify unplayed battles or full progression.

On the next turn, cash in with Extreme Speed rather than continue setting up. Alternate deployment: Hoothoot Tailwind plus Starly gives an immediate attacking mode without Belly Drum. Reserves & disruption: If Drum is unsafe, attack with Zigzagoon or move to the bird pair. Figy is compatible with Adamant; Unnerve, item suppression or removal can deny recovery. Rattled is an opponent-dependent bonus, not an activation plan. Counterplay & audit: Priority immunity/denial, Fake Out on the support, physical mitigation, berry denial or focused damage before Drum resolves. Turn two switches Spinarak when its locked support action no longer produces value. Alternate deployment: Fast control beside Karrablast creates stronger immediate offensive conversion. Reserves & disruption: Dewpider supplies the special Water lane when physical attacks are contained. Do not let a Choice-locked utility move become repeated empty turns. Re-evaluate both targets, turn order, protection, stat-loss immunity, Contrary and retaliatory abilities. Counterplay & audit: Ground immunity blocks Electroweb damage but does not inherently block String Shot. Taunt, Magic Bounce, Clear Amulet, White Herb, speed reversal and punishing switches offer counterplay. Disposition: RETAIN; String Shot replaces Toxic Thread for direct paired speed control, while the Scarf control-and-switch identity remains.
